learning_outcomes.text: Achieving A2 level of the Common European Framework of Reference.
Consolidating and broadening linguistic knowledge acquired in high school.
Developing oral and written communication skills.
Developing skills for understanding written or oral messages.
Familiarization with the cultural and civilization values of other peoples who speak German.

syllabus_topics: Communicating in German in specific situations (engineer's workplace responsibilities, different stages of the production process, teamwork)
Communicating in German in specific professional situations (product presentation: dimensions, shapes, characteristics, materials, units of measurement)
Information gathering techniques (topic setting, research, documentation)
Review and consolidation exercises for studied problems
teaching_methods: Interactive methods based on conversational techniques
assessment_rules: The final grade consists of the activity grade (50%) and the knowledge verification test grade (50%). The minimum performance standard requires the acquisition of at least 50% of the grammar and vocabulary knowledge taught in the seminar. This is verified through exercises similar to those performed during seminars.
